title: The same Groupcoin can be launched more than once
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In `launchGroupCoinToUniswapV3`, there is no validation that the Groupcoin hasn't already been launched. Under normal circumstances, this is not a problem because it's not possible to create multiple pools with the same token pair and fee. However, it's possible for the owner to change the fee at any time via `setUniswapConfig`.
